reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited clause (p0001) expressly states that nothing creates an exclusive arrangement and that the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties — squarely the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph.

Rationale correctly dismisses the other 'exclusive' hits as benign or in our favour (non-exclusive licence to Customer, exclusive jurisdiction, trademark and boilerplate provisions), and the deterministic check confirms no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains.
